newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan August overseas ship orders down 3 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan August overseas ship orders down 3 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Ship export contracts concluded by Japanese shipbuilders in August totalled 13 vessels, or 402,000 gross registered tonnes (grt), down by 3.3 percent from a year earlier, an industry body said on Wednesday.
Orders for August comprised one very large crude carrier (VLCC), two oil product tankers, three chemical tankers, five bulk carriers and two freighters, the Japan Ship Exporters' Association said.
From January through August, Japan received ship orders for 160 vessels, or 5.68 million grt, while South Korea won orders for 70 ships totalling 2.65 million grt, the association said.
